description: Mesoscope event-amplitude quality inputs for the editable Figure 4 A-I layout. The publication renderer reads the two unchanged, checksummed inputs directly, displays one VISp_1 FOV, and preserves all cohort summaries and session points without refitting. The original B/F/J PNG panels and stacked composite below remain archival references, reproducible by scripts/build_mesoscope_unit_extraction_panels.py using the shared package data helpers.

publication_layout.trace_selection: Visual review of the eleven archived High SNR ROIs in VISp_1: ROI 84 has a sparser saved excerpt (56 positive-run OASIS onset indicators versus the legacy ROI 154's 90) and a clearer, more isolated somatic profile. The original 60 s excerpt, masks, and projection are unchanged; this display selection is not a cohort activity estimate.
publication_layout.class_example_selection: Nearest cohort class centroid in the three saved event fractions, restricted to the displayed FOV.
publication_layout.display: Editable vector text/axes; native projection and masks; dense cohort scatter rasterized at 250 dpi. No new extraction, detection, or class fit.

cohort.class_fit: k-means (k = 3) on the standardised (<2, 2-4, >4 SD) event-amplitude fractions, fitted once over the whole cohort and ordered by the centroid's >4 SD fraction
cohort.omission_reason: no resolvable processed-asset path in the session inventory

source_table.row_order: session, cortical area (VISp before VISl), plane, roi_index
source_table.produced_by: scripts/extract_mesoscope_roi_metrics.py (session stage per processed asset on the AIND bucket, then assemble)
source_table.note: One row per ROI. Column subset of the 54-column per-ROI extraction table (sha256 9a99329862c87b4705b2e68415742a229d5c2aa1ab7cbd2e817c5bd91b9fc7f5, 37 MB, not committed); the other columns are by-products of the same pass and are not inputs to these. amp_threshold_quality_class is the cohort-wide k-means fit the panels used; a refit from scratch reproduces the fractions exactly but the k-means objective has several near-equivalent local optima, so a few percent of boundary ROIs can change class with row order or seed. This file is the record of the labels drawn.

note: Regenerate the current publication figure with build-publication-figures. To reproduce only the legacy B/F/J raster references, run python scripts/build_mesoscope_unit_extraction_panels.py --cohort figure_sources/data/mesoscope-unit-extraction-roi-metrics.csv.gz --payload figure_sources/data/mesoscope-unit-extraction-example-session.json --out-dir _build/mesoscope-reproduction. Both paths use only declared dependencies and committed inputs.

example_payload.note: Panel B imagery, ROI masks and the 60 s excerpt traces; the quality classes are joined from source_table on (plane, roi_index).

extraction.session_selection: mesoscope rows of figure_sources/data/experimental-sessions.csv with qc == Pass (83); 81 extracted
extraction.cost: about 9 min and 0.5 GB per session on 2 cores; ~17 core-hours for the cohort
